pagePublic.a_reviewed_privacy_policy_mus: A reviewed privacy policy must define the operator, lawful bases, processors, retention periods, international transfers, user rights, and contact channels. No real security enforcement or account deletion workflow exists in this prototype.

pagePublic.do_not_harass_threaten_impers: Do not harass, threaten, impersonate, scam, or target others with hateful conduct. Unwanted sexual content and abusive behavior are not welcome. Respect everyone’s right to skip or leave.

pagePublic.profile_edits_sample_reports_: Profile edits, sample reports, messages, friends, and uploaded photo previews exist only in application memory and reset on a full page reload. Harmless UI preferences are saved in local browser storage.

pagePublic.these_are_development_placeho: These are development placeholders, not final legal terms. A qualified professional must review governing law, operator details, eligibility, acceptable use, liability, dispute resolution, and account processes before the product is released.
pagePublic.this_platform_is_designed_for: This platform is designed for adults aged 18 and above. The prototype age confirmation is not a substitute for appropriate age assurance before launch.
pagePublic.use_fictional_details_never_s: Use fictional details. Never submit identity documents, financial information, sensitive personal data, or a password you use elsewhere. Profile images selected for testing remain in this browser session.
pagePublic.use_settings_to_adjust_harmle: Use settings to adjust harmless preferences and safety controls to preview reporting and blocking. Clear your browser’s local storage to reset saved preferences. Refresh to clear in-memory demo data.
pagePublic.we_do_not_store_passwords_aut: We do not store passwords, authentication tokens, identity documents, email addresses, phone numbers, or precise locations. No camera or microphone permission is requested. Use fictional information when testing forms.
